limitations: Only exact Rust source/Cargo subset was mirrored, not the entire 931-path source repository tree or hundreds of integration fixture files.
Registry integrity tests inspect 24 cases but do not execute them case-by-case; leave all 216 registry target statuses NOT_EXECUTED.
The successful guest cases prove safe positive control and fail-closed unsafe rejection in the Rust browser/Wasm compiler, not execution of legitimate unsafe operations in a trusted native context.
